novelty.justification: The central novelty route is a new mechanistic relationship: the claim predicts that the “recognition channel contaminates the truth channel” and that this inflation peaks for “recognized-but-unknown” facts, rather than merely proposing another truth or familiarity probe. Searches for “LLM entity familiarity truth judgment,” “recognition signal truth direction hallucination,” “entity popularity false claims LLM internal beliefs,” and “recognition-based truth effect language models” found the closest precedents in Do I Know This Entity? Knowledge Awareness and Hallucinations in Language Models, which connects entity recognition to refusal and hallucination, and Geometry of Truth / Probing the Geometry of Truth, which studies linearly represented truth, but neither establishes the proposed recognition-to-truth contamination. Moving from those works to the claim is a substantive but natural integration of two known representational channels, further motivated by the established human recognition-based truth effect, so it merits standard rather than high novelty: the cross-channel estimand is new, while the underlying phenomenon transfer and probing/steering methods are predictable extensions.
